Results.ReviewText: The packaging of the grill parts is truly impressive, nothing can possibly get damaged. The assembly of all the parts took much longer than expected. Weber uses the same size machine screws and welded on back nuts. They even include an extra couple of screws and that’s a nice touch. This is an upgrade from a 30 year old two burner grill to a three burner with modulating burner control. It will take a wile to learn the grill and how it cooks. I trust in Weber so I hope the grill will out live me.
Results.Title: Old Weber to new

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have always heard that Weber grills are the best but honestly I never believed the hype.  Even when a few of my family members kept telling me they were better and worth the price.  I wasn't sure how much I would use a grill so opted for a lower cost brand which consistently leaked grease everywhere. I finally put it out for a yard sale and sprung for this Weber.  Wow - what a different grilling experience - I love it!  It's just simple and easy and works.  No huge flair ups, no grease dripping everywhere. Now I want to grill everything.  I wish I had bought a Weber first - it is now the standard.
Results.Title: Should have bought it sooner!

Results.ReviewText: It starts up and heats very quickly. Admittedly, my old grill was VERY old, so this grill seems fabulous in comparison. My only minor criticisms would be that some of the parts seem flimsy (like the interior top shelf) and some parts are plastic, which doesn't have a great "feel" to it, but they do stay cool to the touch when the grill is operating. Also, I really can't figure out how to estimate how much fuel is remaining in the propane tank. It's not intuitive, and I don't trust my read of the colrs since I'm red/green colorblind.
Results.Title: Good grill with some tiny issues

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
